EntityBudgetReached.en: Too many entities to build: {1}/{2}. {3} slots are reserved for players, weapons and NPCs.
EntityBudgetReached.chi: 实体过多，无法继续建造：{1}/{2}。已为玩家、武器和丧尸预留{3}个实体。

BuildingNotOwned.en: You can only manage your own or unowned defenses.
BuildingNotOwned.chi: 只能管理自己建造或无主的防御设施。

BuildingTooFar.en: Move closer and aim at this defense to manage it.
BuildingTooFar.chi: 请靠近并瞄准这座防御设施后再操作。

DismantleNoRoom.en: The refund recipient's backpack is full. Make space before dismantling.
DismantleNoRoom.chi: 退款接收者背包容量不足，请先腾出空间再拆除。

BuildingDismantled.en: Defense dismantled. Configured materials have been returned.
BuildingDismantled.chi: 设施已拆除，材料已按配置返还。

DisconnectMaterialsShared.en: {1} left. Their backpack was transferred to {2}'s shared storage; their defenses are now unowned.
DisconnectMaterialsShared.chi: {1}已离开，背包材料已转入{2}共享仓库，留下的设施已变为无主。

DayResetByAdmin.en: An administrator restarted day {1}. Backpacks, storage and surviving defenses are retained.
DayResetByAdmin.chi: 管理员重置了第{1}天，个人背包、共享仓库和存活设施保留。
